entry:
It's time to gain control of your life again, to just focus on being present in this moment and making the best of it. To understand that you can change things to make it work for you, create that reality.

So yes be here, enjoy it, control it, change it. But live it with all your soul, because you are very alive.

notes.title: Subjective Reality
notes.text:
There is no actual reality, but that of each person, we all have our own, and whatever we choose to accept becomes real.

So you can mold your reality to whatever you want.
notes.explanation: topical. It says that you can mold reality.
notes.underlined: “So you can mold your reality to whatever you want.”

notes.title: Accepting Fear
notes.text:
One way of thinking about fear is that if you accept that there are probabilities of positive outcomes, then fear diminishes and acting with it seems like a normal thing to do.

So yes look at fear straight in the eye and go.
notes.explanation: Because it gave insight that there are probabilities of positive outcomes.

notes.title: Desire Over Fear
notes.text: Desire must beat fear
notes.explanation: No reason written.

notes.title: Control What You Can
notes.text: Life is always happening, there are things we can't change, but we can also happen to life, we can change, act upon things we can control, and of those things we must give 100% of our efforts, because even if it is 1 in a million chance, there is a chance.
notes.explanation: Because we can give 100% of our efforts to things we control.

notes.title: Demand More
notes.text:
Stay hungry, stay foolish. Demand, demand, demand value.

Ask for the moon and you might get it.
notes.explanation: Says the same.

notes.title: Fear of Insignificance
notes.text: I don't want to die for nothing, I fear insignificance.
notes.explanation: The reason to do it.

notes.title: Purpose Over Passion
notes.text:
Aim for purpose and realism.

You want to be clear on what you want in life, and have step by step process on how to accomplish it.

Sometimes passion can be formed from ego and rushes into doing things without thinking.

I am not saying that you shouldn't enjoy or love what you do, but sometimes it is grater than that, a purpose, and that only will let you endure hardships that come with what you want to do. Because if you only rely on passion then you will get surprised and ask why it didn't work, regardless of how hard you were working.

Also passion can be flamboyance in disguise, all day talking and romanticizing what we are doing, but then we have little results and it is frustrating.

Purpose is like passion with boundaries, with direction.

Realism is detachment and perspective.

Aim to be in the game, to listen with clarity and ask the right questions. To clearly understand what you are doing and what is next, conscious of what this work entails.
notes.explanation: Insight into having control.

notes.title: Human Mortality
notes.text: We are all humans and we are going to die, knowing that there is nothing stopping me from doing anything, except my perspective on humans. We are all born and we all leave the same earth.
notes.explanation: Perspective is what changes how I do things.
notes.underlined: “there is nothing stopping me from doing anything.”

notes.title: Present Moment
notes.text: Focus on the present moment, the now, that is the only thing you can change or be certain about.
notes.explanation: Same topic.

notes.title: Apply Learning
notes.text:
It is not a time to think things, to feel sorry for yourself. I want to be great, to do the most.

Apply all you have learned once in for all now.

Do it now.
notes.explanation: Because it says that I already know and that I am ready.

notes.title: Just You
notes.text:
Believe in yourself, your mom does. Are you not confident of what you are doing. People has done it, so it is possible. Today is even easier to create something.

You want to be significant, this path is will of doubt and loneliness, but you want it, so at least show the fucking normal people what you are made of. They want to be normal hhahahaahaah. Go fucking harder at everything, be more excellent than yesterday.
notes.explanation: Same topic.

notes.title: Growth Beyond Today
notes.text: You must understand (even more now that you are young) that what you do today, it is not the best work, moment, position that you are going to be. This, today it is just a moment. You will go on to do better, different things, and in constant change.
notes.explanation: No reason written.

notes.title: Seize the Day
notes.text: Carpe diem.
notes.explanation: Same topic.

notes.title: Blocked Paths
notes.text: Somethings will not work at all, no matter how hard you worked. But in that blocked path a new path is revealed. An opportunity to learn. Accept it instantly and move to whatever is next.
notes.explanation: Even if I do my best it might not work and that is fine.

notes.title: What You Control
notes.text:
Distinguish the things that you can or can't change.
Destination stays the same.
notes.explanation: Same topic.

notes.title: High Agency
notes.text:
High agency could be the most important quality to have.

It lets you get stuff done, by disagreeing with conventional wisdom, thinking clearly, and having biased to action.

See past problems, everything can be solvable, go to first principles, ask if it defies the laws of physics.
notes.explanation: Same topic.

notes.title: Know What You Want
notes.text:
You must know what you want in life. What is important, only then you will have higher chances of achieving it and having pleasure in doing so.

If you find yourself saying yes too many things then you are unfocused.

Focus comes from saying No to things that one finds compelling because he is doing something else, his purpose.

Ask yourself why you do what you do until you answer, ask yourself that question every single day.

Focus on doing one thing and never stop until you find it.

Don't do things just because people go successful from those, we all have different races to race, find yours and be the best at it, win your race. Have a clear sense of the space you are in.

Ego leads to envy. It makes you feel insignificant compared to others.

Ask why constantly, find what matters and what doesn't and opt out of races that waste the precious time you have left.
notes.explanation: Insight on how to do it.

notes.title: Life Is Not Singular
notes.text: Life is not singular things happen and they happen for you, you might fail or win, no in between. But in one month you started building with people, you happened, you asked this girl and now you are dating. So never stop trying because if you stay long enough you will succeed.
notes.explanation: Details on what you did and how you happened.

notes.title: Grounding Imagination
notes.text:
The person who lives in a world of his own in his head, loses touch with reality and what is trying to tell him.

Imagination if not controlled can be very dangerous.

Can rob you the ability to think that he even needed to act.

We start to believe what we tell ourselves, good and bad things, which they are never a 100% true. We must live in the tangible and real.

Forget the world we created for ourselves, the stories, the fake feedback and live the now, act on it and create it with actual experiences.
notes.explanation: Being careful with your own reality.

notes.title: Fear Points to Growth
notes.text:
Fear of your work as well as self doubt can be an ally because it tells you that what you are doing matters.

The more scared we are to do something that is what we should be doing first.

If what we are doing means nothing to us then there will be no resistance.

Great people do things that make them suffer, stretch, actually hard things that they haven't done before. And they avoid always doing for the things that don't challenge them.

So if you are paralyzed with fear is a good sign. It shows you what you have to do.
notes.explanation: If you are scared it matters.
